name: Trichloroethane

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States, first in 1977 — for misuse or addiction and heart harm

summary: Trichloroethane was removed from the United States market starting in 1977 due to issues with improper use or addiction and damage to the heart [3]. In addition, a small computer model rather than human testing estimated the risk to the liver with a low score of 4 [M]. The same computer model also gave the substance a low score of 15 for heart risk [M].
